# hyperlite_vm (Data Source)

A VM, to refer to one made elsewhere: reserve its address, back it up, give it a pool.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperlite_vm" "legacy" {
  name = "legacy-app"
}

# Reserve the address of a VM made elsewhere.
resource "hyperlite_network_reservation" "legacy" {
  network = data.hyperlite_vm.legacy.network_interface[0].network
  mac     = data.hyperlite_vm.legacy.network_interface[0].mac
  ip      = "10.0.20.60"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The VM's name.

### Optional

- `node` (String) The node it is on (`local` when absent).

### Read-Only

- `firmware` (String) `bios` or `uefi`.
- `id` (String) Its UUID.
- `ip` (String) Its address, when it runs and reports one.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory, in MB.
- `network_interface` (List of Object) Its interfaces, in order: `mac` and `network`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_interface))
- `state` (String) `active`, `stopped`, `paused`...
- `vcpu` (Number) Virtual CPUs.

<a id="nestedatt--network_interface"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_interface`

Read-Only:

- `mac` (String)
- `network` (String)
